decisions.reason: As a prominently presented core complement to the firm's garage-door system range, it is likely seen as strategically important and worth retaining while early market feedback accumulates.

The solid wood sectional door fits the firm's customization logic and broad portfolio strategy, so a large firm with some slack would usually keep it unless early results were clearly below aspiration.
Although it overlaps with the broader operator line and could later be folded into it, the firm would likely keep this recently launched convenience variant while evaluating acceptance.

This industrial glazed door appears to be a narrower offering with less prominence, but it still supports the one-stop industrial door portfolio and is unlikely to be cut after only a short trial period.
The insulated glazed industrial door matches customer needs for compliant thermal and industrial solutions, making it a plausible keeper unless sales quickly fall well short of internal aspirations.
Because it received its own page and strengthens the firm's industrial sectional door range, management would likely judge it worth continuing through the uncertainty of its early market phase.
